ConnectionStrings.//: No credential belongs in this file. Supply ConnectionStrings__Default through the environment or a secret store.

Jwt.//: Issuer and Audience are inherited from appsettings.json. Only SigningKey is omitted here, and startup fails while the placeholder is still in place.

Redis.//: Set Redis__Configuration to the shared cache. Disabling it falls back to per-process memory, which is not shared between replicas.

Database.//: Set Database__ApplyMigrationsOnStartup=false when a deployment pipeline applies migrations as a separate, gated step. Several replicas migrating at once contend for the same migration lock.

Cors.//: Set Cors__AllowedOrigins__0..n to the exact browser origins. An empty list allows no browser origin at all.

Proxy.//: Enable only behind a reverse proxy, and list that proxy. Without it, rate limiting and audit records see the proxy address instead of the client.
